leadText:
Asuka Iwashita (Japanese: ) is a conceptual character artist for , specifically the sixth, seventh, and twelfth Pokémon movies. In addition to these three movies, she worked on the special episode The Mastermind of Mirage Pokémon.

In addition to working on Pokémon the Series, Iwashita worked as a graphic designer for multiple Pokémon games from through . In addition to being a designer for the games' graphics, she is also credited for designing Pokémon in Generation III.

As an illustrator for the Pokémon Trading Card Game, Asuka Iwashita illustrated cards, beginning in 2001. Her first illustrations were featured in , in which she illustrated all of Sabrina's featured Pokémon. In 2004, three years after illustrating these cards, she was credited as an illustrator for the last time on .
